prompt: Generate one image: a finished, high-fidelity desktop website landing page design, 16:9 landscape, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window, no device, no desk). Two images are attached. Image 1 shows the REAL Lonca logomark and icon: reproduce that exact mark (pixel-block icon + blocky "lonca" wordmark), single flat colour (light on dark), never redraw or restyle it. Image 2 is a STYLE reference sheet only (Nango primary, plus Linear, Vercel, Resend): match its craft, near-black ground, hairline grid lines framing a centred content column, crisp neutral greys, one accent colour, refined grotesk type, small mono labels, real code cards; do NOT copy any of their text, logos or products. Product: Lonca, an open-source-engine marketplace integrator for Turkish marketplace sellers (Trendyol, Hepsiburada; n11 coming). The seller panel is coming soon, small sellers will always be free, the open-source TypeScript SDKs exist today. Accent colour: Lonca blue #3D7BE0 on near-black #0A0B0D, text #EDEFF2, muted #8A919C, hairlines #1E2228. All page text in Turkish. Composition C (Vercel-like bold hero where the integration hub is the focal object). 1. Top nav: exact Lonca logomark left; links "Satıcılar", "Geliştiriciler", "Fiyatlar", "Dokümanlar"; right: GitHub star chip and white pill "Bekleme listesi". 2. Hero left: headline very large "Lisanssız entegrasyon." and second line in muted grey "Amiral gemisi işi, sıfır lisans."; subline "Trendyol ve Hepsiburada için açık kaynak motorlu entegratör. Panel yakında; küçük satıcıya her zaman ücretsiz."; email field + accent button "Bekleme listesine yazıl"; mono line "npm i @lonca/trendyol". 3. THE FOCAL MOVE, centre-right: a glowing integration hub diagram drawn with hairlines on black: left nodes "Trendyol", "Hepsiburada", "n11 (yakında)" as small dark pills; their lines converge into a central luminous square node built from the Lonca pixel-block icon labelled "Lonca motoru · açık kaynak"; from it two lines go right: a solid line to "Kendi kodun · bugün" and a dashed line to "Lonca Panel · yakında". Small accent dots travel along the lines. Soft white glow behind the central node like Vercel's triangle. 4. Bottom of the frame: the start of the next section, a hairline-boxed three-column row "Yıllık lisans yok", "API her pakette açık", "Motor açık kaynak (MIT)". Body text at real readable size. Real content only: no customer logos, no testimonials, no user counts, no marketplace logos (names in plain text are fine), no competitor names, no prices for paid plans.
